lines: Hi! I'm Prue! I'm Nina's sister! I'm seven and three quarters! Do you like plushies? I have nine. Ten if you count the sock.
Look, look! I won a ribbon for the best scarecrow drawing! Mine's got a cape.
Bruno says the hayride's for babies. He's been on it three times.
It's the weekend! I don't have to do spellings till Sunday night.
Do you want to play on the slide? You go first. I'll count.
Poppy lets me lick the spoon if I say please in a posh voice.
I'm reading a book about a dragon who's scared of the dark. He gets a nightlight. It's very good.
I'm looking for the biggest pumpkin in the whole patch. This one's big. But that one's BIGGER.
Swings! Push me! Higher! HIGHER! ...Okay that's high enough.
This is my room. It's lilac. Lilac is purple but nicer.

rotate: I saw a little green alien in the pumpkin patch! Nina says it was a squash. Squashes don't wave!
Bruno lets me ride his skateboard if I sit down on it. It's still skating!
Mr. Palmer gave me a sweet. It was green. It fizzed. I don't know where he got it.
